parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of metal, slender and elongated, connecting the frame to the ear area.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain stability and comfort.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of metal, similar to the left leg, providing balance and support.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the glasses in place on the right side of the wearer’s head and ensures even pressure distribution.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for compact storage or open outward for use.

parts.name: Outlier (Nose Bridge)
parts.Basic_description: This is the nose bridge of the eyeglasses, a small curved metal piece connecting the two lenses.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and rests on the wearer’s nose, distributing the weight of the glasses evenly.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move, serving as a rigid connector between the two lens frames.

parts.name: Base Body (Lens and Frame)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the lenses and surrounding frame, made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses that correct or protect vision and provides the main structure for the eyeglasses.
parts.Movement_description: It is a rigid component that does not move, serving as the central support for all other parts.
